paragraphs.zh: 一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺
paragraphs.en: A synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione
paragraphs.notes: Invention title. Printed centred and in bold immediately below the running head, carrying no paragraph marker. This is body content, not a header artifact, so it is recorded as a paragraph rather than folded into `header`. 环磺酮 is this patent's Chinese common name for tembotrione and it is used consistently on this page; note that the reference patent CN104292137A in this same dataset writes the same compound as 环磺草酮. Recorded as printed here, not harmonised.
Section heading, printed in bold at the left margin with a full-width colon '：'. No paragraph marker. Carries no marker so downstream marker counting is unaffected.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明属于农药原药的制备领域，具体涉及一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺。
paragraphs.en: The present invention belongs to the field of preparation of pesticide technical active ingredients, and specifically relates to a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione.
paragraphs.notes: PROVENANCE FOR THIS WHOLE PAGE. CN109678767A is born digital: every page carries a real embedded text layer, and every `zh` field on this page was EXTRACTED from that text layer character for character. None of the Chinese on this page was read off pixels by a model. The page image was used only for layout (running head, footer, section headings, paragraph order, and the fact that there is no drawing anywhere on the page) and for high-magnification spot-checks of the characters; every check agreed with the text layer. TRANSCRIPTION CONVENTION FOR THIS WHOLE PAGE: the text layer breaks each paragraph at the printed line ends. Those breaks are typesetting, not content, and have been joined with NO character inserted. Nothing else was normalised. Full-width punctuation (，、；。：％) and half-width punctuation (the locant commas in '2,2,2-' and '1,3-', the parentheses around Latin names such as '(Tembotrione)', the hyphens in chemical names) are reproduced exactly as the text layer holds them, and the two widths are reliable on this page because they come from the publication's own encoding rather than from reading ink. The printed page inserts variable justification whitespace around Latin and digit runs (the image shows '２００７年' widely tracked, for example); the text layer does not carry that whitespace and none has been added. The section heading '技术领域：' printed directly above this paragraph is recorded as its own marker-less paragraph entry, as is the invention title above it. HEADER FIELD: assembled from the three header zones the image shows left, centre and right; the ideographic spaces inside '说　明　书' are the text layer's own (U+3000), while the runs of plain spaces separating the three zones are this record's, not the publication's. 农药原药 is the technical-grade active ingredient (the pure active substance before formulation), rendered here as 'pesticide technical active ingredients'.

Section heading, printed in bold at the left margin with a full-width colon '：'. No paragraph marker. Everything from here to the foot of the page ([0002] through [0008]) is the patent's account of the state of the art, i.e. PRIOR ART, and none of it is the invention's own route. No route of any kind is drawn on this page.

paragraphs.zh: 除草剂环磺酮(Tembotrione)，化学名称：2-{2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-[(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基]苯甲酰基}环己烷-1,3-二酮，是由拜耳公司2007年研制的三酮类玉米田除草剂，其活性高于硝磺酮(硝磺草酮、甲基磺草酮)，对作物安全。环磺酮主要用于玉米田，是芽后HPPD(对羟基苯基丙酮酸双氧化酶)抑制剂类除草剂，可阻断植株体内异戊二烯基醌的生物合成，引起失绿、褪色、组织坏死，最终在2周内死亡。环磺酮除草谱广、除草适期长，主要靶标玉米田芽后中晚期各种阔叶杂草与禾本科杂草，对蓟、田旋花、婆婆纳、辣子草、鼬瓣花和猪殃殃等防效优异，且对后茬作物无药害，是美国玉米田最重要的除草剂之一，每季最大用药量为100g/hm2，主要剂型为：可分散油悬浮剂。
paragraphs.en: The herbicide tembotrione (Tembotrione), chemical name: 2-{2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione, is a triketone-class maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of nitrosulfone/mesotrione (硝磺酮) (mesotrione, methyl sulcotrione), and it is safe to the crop. Tembotrione is used mainly in maize fields; it is a post-emergence HPPD (4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase) inhibitor herbicide, which can block the biosynthesis of prenyl (isoprenoid) quinones inside the plant, causing chlorosis, discoloration and tissue necrosis, and finally death within 2 weeks. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the mid-to-late post-emergence stage in maize fields, and it has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, hemp-nettle and cleavers, causes no phytotoxicity to the succeeding crop, and is one of the most important herbicides in United States maize fields, with a maximum application rate of 100 g/hm2 per season; the main formulation type is: oil dispersion (dispersible oil suspension concentrate).
paragraphs.notes: NAMING CONFLICT ON THIS PAGE, flagged and not corrected: this paragraph writes '其活性高于硝磺酮(硝磺草酮、甲基磺草酮)' - three characters, 硝磺酮, glossed parenthetically as 硝磺草酮 and 甲基磺草酮 - whereas [0003] on the same page writes 硝磺草酮 (mesotrione). Both come from the embedded text layer and both were confirmed against the image at high magnification. 硝磺草酮 and 甲基磺草酮 are both established Chinese names for mesotrione; 硝磺酮 is not, and is most likely a contraction, but it is transcribed and translated as printed. See discrepancies. The chemical name given here, 2-{2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-[(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基]苯甲酰基}环己烷-1,3-二酮, is tembotrione and is internally consistent with the title compound, but no structure is drawn anywhere on this page, so the identification rests on the printed name alone. '100g/hm2' is printed with a BASELINE '2', not a superscript, in both the text layer and the ink; hm2 is the square hectometre, i.e. the hectare, so the rate is 100 g per hectare per season. Reproduced as printed. 对羟基苯基丙酮酸双氧化酶 is translated literally as 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase, which is what the abbreviation HPPD printed beside it denotes. 异戊二烯基醌 is translated literally as prenyl (isoprenoid) quinone. The six weeds are Chinese common names and are translated by their usual English common names: 蓟 thistle (Cirsium), 田旋花 field bindweed (Convolvulus arvensis), 婆婆纳 speedwell (Veronica), 辣子草 gallant soldier (Galinsoga), 鼬瓣花 hemp-nettle (Galeopsis), 猪殃殃 cleavers (Galium aparine). The botanical binomials are glosses supplied here for the reader; they are NOT printed in the patent. 可分散油悬浮剂 is the OD (oil dispersion) formulation type.

paragraphs.zh: 目前开发的三酮结构HPPD类除草剂还有硝磺草酮、磺草酮、双环磺草酮等，环磺酮的活性要高于硝磺草酮，相较于其他品种，环磺酮对多种杂草有很强的杀灭作用，无残留活性，有较强的抗雨水冲刷能力，且除草谱更广。
paragraphs.en: The triketone-structure HPPD herbicides developed so far also include mesotrione, sulcotrione, benzobicyclon and others; the activity of tembotrione is higher than that of mesotrione, and compared with the other varieties tembotrione has a very strong killing action on many kinds of weeds, has no residual activity, has a comparatively strong resistance to rain wash-off, and its weed-control spectrum is broader.
paragraphs.notes: 硝磺草酮 = mesotrione, 磺草酮 = sulcotrione, 双环磺草酮 = benzobicyclon. These are the standard Chinese common names and are printed here in full, unlike the 硝磺酮 of [0002]. 无残留活性 is translated literally as 'has no residual activity'; the Chinese is ambiguous between 'leaves no residue' and 'has no soil residual action', and the reading has not been picked for it.

paragraphs.zh: 2007年，环磺酮在奥地利首先取得登记，产品中加入了安全剂双苯噁唑酸(isoxadifen)，商品名为Laudis，用于防除玉米田禾本科杂草和阔叶杂草；同年，该产品还在美国和匈牙利取得登记；2008年在巴西登记；2009年在葡萄牙登记。2010年，环磺酮与噻酮磺隆(thiencarbazone)的复配产品Capreno在美国上市，其后在欧洲和拉美取得进一步登记。
paragraphs.en: In 2007 tembotrione was first registered in Austria; the safener isoxadifen was added to the product, whose trade name is Laudis, for the control of grass weeds and broadleaf weeds in maize fields. In the same year the product was also registered in the United States and Hungary; in 2008 it was registered in Brazil; in 2009 it was registered in Portugal. In 2010 Capreno, the co-formulated product of tembotrione with thiencarbazone, was launched in the United States, and subsequently obtained further registrations in Europe and Latin America.
paragraphs.notes: 双苯噁唑酸 is glossed in the patent itself as (isoxadifen) and is the safener; 噻酮磺隆 is glossed as (thiencarbazone). Both English names are the patent's own parentheticals, not translations supplied here. The commercial products isoxadifen-ethyl and thiencarbazone-methyl are the registered ester forms, but the patent prints the un-esterified names and they have not been amended. The image prints '2007年' at the start of this paragraph with wide justification tracking between the digits; the text layer carries the digits with no spacing and that is what is recorded. This is registration history, not chemistry; no reagent, yield or structure appears in this paragraph.

paragraphs.zh: 拜耳公司的专利号CN1323292A报道了以2,6-二氯甲苯为起始原料合成环磺酮的工艺，在制备2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的时候，以NBS为溴化剂，会有大量固废产生，且收率偏低，只有67％。
paragraphs.en: Bayer's patent No. CN1323292A reports a process for synthesising tembotrione from 2,6-dichlorotoluene as the starting material; when preparing methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, NBS is used as the brominating agent, a large amount of solid waste is produced, and the yield is on the low side, only 67%.
paragraphs.notes: PRIOR ART, as characterised by this patent's own background section. The 67％ figure is the prior patent's yield as reported here, not a result of the present invention. The percent sign is the full-width '％' in the source. NBS is printed in Latin letters and is N-bromosuccinimide; the patent does not expand it. Starting material 2,6-二氯甲苯 = 2,6-dichlorotoluene. No structure is drawn.

paragraphs.zh: 黑龙江大学的专利号CN105601548A报道了以3-氯-2-甲基苯胺为起始原料合成环磺酮的工艺在制备2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的时候，也是以昂贵NBS为溴化剂，会有大量固废产生，且收率偏低，只有75.2％。
paragraphs.en: Heilongjiang University's patent No. CN105601548A reports a process for synthesising tembotrione from 3-chloro-2-methylaniline as the starting material in which, when preparing methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, expensive NBS is likewise used as the brominating agent, a large amount of solid waste is produced, and the yield is on the low side, only 75.2%.
paragraphs.notes: PRIOR ART. This sentence is a RUN-ON as printed: it reads '...合成环磺酮的工艺在制备2-氯-3-溴甲基...' with NO comma after 工艺, where the parallel sentences in [0005] and [0007] both print '工艺，在制备'. Confirmed in the text layer and in the ink at high magnification. Transcribed as printed; the English keeps the same joined construction rather than resolving it into two clauses. 75.2％ uses a half-width decimal point and a full-width percent sign, as printed. Starting material 3-氯-2-甲基苯胺 = 3-chloro-2-methylaniline. No structure is drawn.

paragraphs.zh: 武汉工程大学的专利号CN104292137A报道了以2-氯甲苯为起始原料合成环磺酮的工艺，在制备2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的时候，以危险性较大的溴素为溴化剂，收率偏低，只有70％；在制备2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的时候，所用2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠目前无法大规模生产，买不到原料；在制备环磺酮的时候，使用氰基丙酮价格过于昂贵，生产成本高，而且中间态2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸-3-氧代-1-环己烯酯单独分离处理，导致工艺繁琐，收率偏低，只有69％。
paragraphs.en: Wuhan Institute of Technology's patent No. CN104292137A reports a process for synthesising tembotrione from 2-chlorotoluene as the starting material; when preparing methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, the comparatively hazardous elemental bromine is used as the brominating agent and the yield is on the low side, only 70%; when preparing 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, the sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide used cannot at present be produced on a large scale and the raw material cannot be bought; when preparing tembotrione, the cyanoacetone used is too expensive so production costs are high, and moreover the intermediate 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is isolated and worked up separately, which makes the process cumbersome, and the yield is on the low side, only 69%.
paragraphs.notes: PRIOR ART, and specifically the patent CN104292137A that is the reference run of this dataset. This paragraph is therefore cross-checkable against that patent's own text, but nothing here has been adjusted to match it. 溴素 = elemental bromine (Br2). 2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠 = sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide. 氰基丙酮 = cyanoacetone, read literally; it is NOT 丙酮氰醇 (acetone cyanohydrin), and the same literal reading was recorded for CN104292137A's own text. NAME FORM: the enol ester intermediate is printed here as '2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸-3-氧代-1-环己烯酯', WITH a hyphen between 苯甲酸 and 3-氧代. CN104292137A prints the same name without that hyphen (苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯). A name parser must not treat the hyphen as a locant separator on the acid; the Chinese ester construction is 'ACID + ALCOHOL-part + 酯' and the English rendering puts the alcohol part first, as is conventional. Three separate yields are attributed in this paragraph: 70％ for the bromination step, and 69％ which the sentence attaches to the tembotrione preparation step. Whether 69％ is a step yield or an overall yield is not stated and has not been inferred. No structure is drawn.

paragraphs.zh: 安徽久易农业股份有限公司的专利号CN106008290A报道了环磺酮的合成工艺，在制备2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的时候，所用2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠目前无法大规模生产，买不到原料；在制备环磺酮的时候，用到了昂贵的缩合剂，且用量较大，合成成本偏高。
paragraphs.en: Anhui Jiuyi Agriculture Co., Ltd.'s patent No. CN106008290A reports a synthesis process for tembotrione in which, when preparing 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, the sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide used cannot at present be produced on a large scale and the raw material cannot be bought; and when preparing tembotrione, an expensive condensing agent is used, in a fairly large amount, so the synthesis cost is on the high side.
paragraphs.notes: PRIOR ART, and the last paragraph on the page. 缩合剂 = condensing (coupling) agent; the paragraph does not name it, and no name has been supplied. No yield figure is given for this route, unlike [0005] to [0007]. No structure is drawn. Below this paragraph the page is blank down to the centred footer '3'.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text (there are NO drawings on this page). Mesotrione is named two different ways within the same page.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing anywhere on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0002] prints '其活性高于硝磺酮(硝磺草酮、甲基磺草酮)', using the three-character form 硝磺酮 as the head term and glossing it with 硝磺草酮 and 甲基磺草酮. [0003] prints 硝磺草酮 twice as the head term. 硝磺草酮 and 甲基磺草酮 are both standard Chinese names for mesotrione; 硝磺酮 is not standard. Both forms come from the embedded text layer and were confirmed in the ink at high magnification. Recorded as printed, not harmonised.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. [0006] is printed as a run-on where the parallel sentences [0005] and [0007] carry a comma.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing anywhere on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0006] reads '...为起始原料合成环磺酮的工艺在制备2-氯-3-溴甲基...的时候' with no comma after 工艺, whereas [0005] reads '...合成环磺酮的工艺，在制备...' and [0007] reads '...合成环磺酮的工艺，在制备...'. Confirmed in both the text layer and the ink. Almost certainly a dropped comma, transcribed verbatim and left unfixed; the English keeps the joined construction.

discrepancies.what: Text-layer-vs-image. The embedded text layer emits the running head and the footer AFTER the body and emits the page number twice; the image shows the head at the top and one page number at the bottom.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The image shows, in reading order: running head 'CN 109678767 A' left / '说　明　书' centre / '1/9 页' right, under a full-width rule; then the title; then the body; then a single centred '3' at the foot. Nothing else is on the page.
discrepancies.text_says: The text layer ends with the sequence '说　明　书', '1/9 页', '3', 'CN 109678767 A', '3' - the head and footer components appended after the body, and '3' appearing twice where the ink shows it once. Layout was taken from the image per the run's rule that the image wins for layout and the text layer wins for characters; the duplicate '3' is treated as an extraction artifact and the footer is recorded once.

discrepancies.what: Naming-form variation that a downstream name parser must not read as a structural difference.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing anywhere on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0007] prints the enol-ester intermediate as '...苯甲酸-3-氧代-1-环己烯酯' WITH a hyphen joining 苯甲酸 to 3-氧代, while the patent it is describing, CN104292137A, prints '...苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯' without it. Same compound; the hyphen is orthographic and is not a locant on the benzoic acid ring.

notes: This page is 说明书 1/9页, the opening page of the description: invention title, 技术领域 with [0001], and 背景技术 with [0002] through [0008]. NO DRAWING OF ANY KIND APPEARS ON THIS PAGE - no structure, no reaction scheme, no table, no formula image. The whole page is prose, and the lower roughly 8 percent below [0008] is blank apart from the centred footer '3'. PROVENANCE: CN109678767A is born digital and this page carries a real embedded text layer, so every `zh` field here was EXTRACTED from that layer character for character rather than transcribed from pixels by a model. The page image supplied the layout and confirmed the characters at high magnification; the two agreed everywhere. See the [0001] note for the full transcription convention. ATTRIBUTION: everything on this page from 背景技术 onwards is the patent's own account of PRIOR ART - four earlier routes to tembotrione (CN1323292A, CN105601548A, CN104292137A, CN106008290A) and the objections this patent raises to each. None of it is the invention's own route, and the invention's route is not stated or drawn on this page. page_confidence is high and reflects the worst part of the page, which is still high: nothing is illegible, nothing is inferred, and the only open questions are the printing irregularities recorded in discrepancies.
